name: clean_coat_system_table
text:
[p.42]
SECTION 09 96 00 — HIGH-PERFORMANCE COATINGS
3.2 TANK EXTERIOR: Surfaces shall be blast cleaned to SSPC-SP10 near-white metal. Apply one coat organic zinc-rich primer at 3.0-5.0 mils DFT, one intermediate epoxy coat at 4.0-6.0 mils DFT, and one polyurethane finish coat at 2.0-4.0 mils DFT.

name: environmental_limits_and_holds
text:
[p.55]
Application shall not proceed when relative humidity exceeds 85% or when surface temperature is less than 5°F above the dew point. The Contractor shall notify the Owner's inspector 48 hours prior to commencing surface preparation; surface preparation acceptance is a WITNESS POINT.
